cards.questionText:
Office World

We offer the highest quality office supplies. Stock your supply room now with pens, tape, paper, and so much more!
From July 10 to 15, we are offering 15 percent off on all kinds of paper. *Take the time to browse through our selections of plain and specialty paper at www.officeworld.com. We have embossed, parchment, and colored paper for you to choose from. We can even print your letterhead for an additional charge. Order now as our special offer applies to letterhead printing! Expedited delivery service is free within California and available for a reasonable fee in other areas. Orders will be delivered to your address within three to five days of purchase.
*This offer is good while supplies last. Go to www.officeworld.com today for information on all our sale and regular items.

______________________________________________

TO: Purchasing department [purchasing@officeworld.com]
FROM: Ted Neilson [tneil@clarksontrading.com]
SUBJECT: Order request
DATE: July 10
ATTACHMENT: clarkson trading
Dear Office World,
I came across your advertisement and am interested in ordering some of your paper and supplies in large quantities for my company. I'd like to order some company letterheads on cream-colored paper, plain white paper, plastic cases, boxes for storage, and some sticky notes. The details are included in the attachment.
If you have any questions, you may contact me on my mobile phone at (402) 555-9488. I hope to hear from you soon. Thank you.
Sincerely,
Ted Neilson

______________________________________________
 

Office World
Order Number: 0000438384943
Order Date: July 11
Customer Name: Clarkson Trading, Inc.

Item Description Quantity Unit Price Amount
Stationery, cream, A4 size 5,000 $11.98/100 sheets $599.00
Letterhead printing 5,000 $0.45/page $2,250.00
Stationery, white, A4 size 8,000 $8.98/100 sheets $718.40
Archival box 15 $19.76/box $296.40
Plastic paper case 24 $4.40/case $105.60

 

Sub- total $3,969.40
Discount: 15% $535.11
Shipping $160.00
TOTAL $3,594.29

 Please note:
- A discount has been applied for the paper items in your order.
- An additional fee of $160 was charged for expedited delivery.
- Please pay by bank transfer to the account number sent by text message to your phone.
- Your order will not be processed until payment is complete.

childQuestions.questionText: In the advertisement, the phrase "browse through" in paragraph 2, is closest in meaning to
options: (A) read
(B) search
(C) track
(D) inquire
childQuestions.transcript: browse (v): to look through information (on the internet) without reading everything => similar meaning to search
childQuestions.explanationVi: browse (v): tìm kiếm thông tin (trên internet) mà không đọc hết mọi thứ => nghĩa tương tự như tìm kiếm

childQuestions.questionText: Why did Mr. Neilson write the e-mail?
options: (A) To report a delay in receiving an order
(B) To purchase some supplies in bulk
(C) To ask for product price details
(D) To inquire about a shipping status
correctOptions: (B) To purchase some supplies in bulk
childQuestions.transcript: Information: I came across your advertisement and am interested in ordering some of your paper and supplies in large quantities for my company.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin: Tôi tình cờ thấy quảng cáo của bạn và quan tâm đến việc đặt hàng một số loại giấy và vật tư của bạn với số lượng lớn cho công ty của tôi.

childQuestions.questionText: How will Clarkson Trading pay for the order?
options: (A) By charging it to a credit card
(B) By issuing a personal check
(C) By wiring money to an account
(D) By using accumulated points
correctOptions: (C) By wiring money to an account
childQuestions.transcript: Information: Please pay by bank transfer to the account number sent by text message to your phone.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin: Vui lòng thanh toán bằng chuyển khoản ngân hàng vào số tài khoản được gửi qua tin nhắn đến điện thoại của bạn.

childQuestions.questionText: Why was Clarkson Trading charged an additional fee?
options: (A) It exceeded a weight limitation.
(B) It is located outside California.
(C) It ordered a special item.
(D) It missed a promotional period.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information: Expedited delivery service is free within California and available for a reasonable fee in other areas.

But: An additional fee of $160 was charged for expedited delivery.

=> Clarkson Trading is located outside California.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin: Dịch vụ giao hàng nhanh miễn phí trong bang California và có sẵn với một khoản phí hợp lý ở các khu vực khác.

Nhưng: Một khoản phí bổ sung $160 đã được tính cho dịch vụ giao hàng nhanh.

=> Clarkson Trading nằm ngoài bang California.

childQuestions.questionText: What requested item did Office World forget to provide in the invoice?
options: (A) The specialty paper
(B) The storage boxes
(C) The padded envelope
(D) The adhesive paper
childQuestions.transcript:
Compare items in the email and the invoice: I'd like to order some company letterheads on cream-colored paper, plain white paper, plastic cases, boxes for storage, and some sticky notes. 

=> Lack the sticky notes (adhesive paper)

cards.questionText:
Portami Bags
  Home  I Products  I Clearance items  I Contact  I Shopping cart

Porta Bello Mobile Device Bag:
• Made of durable polyester with a genuine leather trim
• Includes adjustable straps and a spacious main compartment
• Interior pockets store small personal belongings and a mobile phone
• Available in black, gray, brown, red, and beige
Click here for further images or here to place an order.

 ______________________________________________

TO: Customer service [cservice@portamibags.com]
FROM: Amy Baron [baron_amy@benchbustraining.org]
SUBJECT: Order inquiry
DATE: September 30

My name is Amy Baron, and I work for Bench Business Training Center in Tacoma. We are looking for a special and practical item to give away to participants who complete our courses. In doing so, we hope to promote our center as well. A colleague at our branch office in Seattle recently purchased one of your bags for mobile devices and recommended it for its design, quality, and reasonable cost.
I am wondering if your company would consider offering us a discount if we placed a large order. Also, our organization's logo is navy blue, so we want the bags made of matching blue material. To improve brand recognition, we want our name and logo noticeably displayed on the front of each bag. If all of these terms are agreeable to you, we would like to place an initial order for 1,000 pieces.
Feel free to call me at 555-3409 to discuss this further, or you can reply to this e-mail.
Amy Baron

______________________________________________

Customer Review: Porta Bello Mobile Device Bag
Manufacturer: Portami Bags
Name: Amy Baron (baron_amy@benchbustraining.org)
Not only are these finely crafted bags extremely useful and practical, but the customer service from the manufacturer was excellent. I contacted Portami Bags about a bulk order, and it was very accommodating of them to produce the bags for me in blue. They also put us in touch with a partner company that did some customized printing on the items. The price of the bags was very reasonable considering the excellent quality.

childQuestions.questionText: What is NOT indicated about the mobile device bag?
options: (A) It is made of two different materials.
(B) It has multiple pockets and compartments.
(C) It comes in a variety of sizes.
(D) It can be purchased on a Web site.
correctOptions: (C) It comes in a variety of sizes.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information for (A): Made of durable polyester with a genuine leather trim

Information for (B): Includes adjustable straps and a spacious main compartment

Information for (D): Click here for further images or here to place an order. (by through the web page)
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin cho (A): Được làm từ polyester bền với viền da thật.

Thông tin cho (B): Bao gồm dây đeo có thể điều chỉnh và ngăn chính rộng rãi.

Thông tin cho (D): Nhấp vào đây để xem thêm hình ảnh hoặc vào đây để đặt hàng.

childQuestions.questionText: Why is Bench Business Training Center giving away bags?
options: (A) To reward loyal customers
(B) To promote its facility
(C) To recognize top employees
(D) To publicize a future location
childQuestions.transcript: Information: We are looking for a special and practical item to give away to participants who complete our courses.  In doing so, we hope to promote our center as well.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin: Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một món đồ đặc biệt và thực tế để tặng cho những người tham gia hoàn thành các khóa học của chúng tôi. Bằng cách đó, chúng tôi cũng hy vọng sẽ quảng bá trung tâm của mình.

childQuestions.questionText: In the e-mail, the word "noticeably" in paragraph 2, is closest in meaning to
options: (A) prominently
(B) diplomatically
(C) significantly
(D) capably
childQuestions.transcript: noticeably (adv): in a way that is easy to see or recognize = prominently
childQuestions.explanationVi: noticeably (adv) = prominently:  theo cách dễ thấy hoặc nhận ra

childQuestions.questionText: What does Ms. Baron indicate about Portami Bags?
options: (A) It added a number of bags to her order for free.
(B) It customized an order for her in a color not offered.
(C) It provided her with a complimentary gift for placing an order.
(D) It suggested an alternative to a product she had previously requested.
correctOptions: (B) It customized an order for her in a color not offered.
childQuestions.transcript:
According to the advertisement, the bag is available in black, gray, brown, red, and beige, but Ms. Baron wants her bags in blue

Information: I contacted Portami Bags about a bulk order, and it was very accommodating of them to produce the bags for me in blue. They also put us in touch with a partner company that did some customized printing on the items.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Theo quảng cáo, túi có sẵn các màu đen, xám, nâu, đỏ và be, nhưng bà Baron muốn túi của mình có màu xanh.

Thông tin: Tôi đã liên hệ với Portami Bags về một đơn đặt hàng số lượng lớn, và họ đã rất linh hoạt khi sản xuất túi cho tôi bằng màu xanh. Họ cũng đã kết nối chúng tôi với một công ty đối tác để in tùy chỉnh lên các sản phẩm.

childQuestions.questionText: What can be inferred about Bench Business Training Center?
options: (A) It purchased bags for two of its locations.
(B) It was able to secure a discount on its order.
(C) It revised the size of its initial order of bags.
(D) It got positive comments on the bags from its customers.
correctOptions: (B) It was able to secure a discount on its order.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information in the email: I am wondering if your company would consider offering us a discount if we placed a large order...If all of these terms are agreeable to you, we would like to place an initial order for 1,000 pieces.

Information in customer review: The price of the bags was very reasonable considering the excellent quality.

=> Bench Business Training Center was able to secure a discount on its order.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin trong email: Tôi tự hỏi liệu công ty của bạn có xem xét việc cung cấp cho chúng tôi một khoản chiết khấu nếu chúng tôi đặt một đơn hàng lớn... Nếu tất cả các điều khoản này được bạn chấp nhận, chúng tôi muốn đặt đơn hàng ban đầu là 1.000 sản phẩm.

Thông tin trong đánh giá của khách hàng: Giá của các túi rất hợp lý khi xét đến chất lượng tuyệt vời.

=> Trung tâm Đào tạo Doanh nghiệp Bench đã có thể nhận được chiết khấu cho đơn đặt hàng của mình.

cards.questionText:
Save money on your international calls!

Elite Wireless is now pleased to offer all its regular plan users unlimited* international calls and texting! So, if you have friends, family, or business associates abroad, the Elite Regular Plan is now a perfect match for you. With fees starting as low as $50 per month when you sign up for a one-year contract, you can save hundreds of dollars on international calls. Sign up for 12 months by April 1, and pay nothing for your first month of service! Find out about this special offer as well as our prepaid mobile plans and packages for businesses at www.elitewireless.com.
*Not all countries are applicable. To see a list of applicable locations, check the Web site.

______________________________________________

February 20
Joann Majors
1919 Crestside Drive
Kansas City, MO 64101
Dear Ms. Majors,
We hope that you are enjoying your phone, text, and data service from Elite Wireless Telecommunications. Your current plan is:
Prepaid Cell Phone
- unlimited talk, text, and 1 gigabyte of data
- $40 prepaid month-to-month
- additional fees apply for international calls
We have analyzed your usage pattern and would like to recommend a plan that is more suitable to your needs. During the past six months, you made a few international calls and consumed an average of 3 gigabytes of data per month. Based on these findings, we recommend you switch to our regular plan:
One year contract
- unlimited talk, text, and 3 gigabytes data including international calls and texts
- a complimentary mobile phone (three models available)
- $50 per month
To activate the new service, simply visit www.elitewireless. com and enroll using this special code: 5A6792B, or call 555-8383. You may also feel free to e-mail me at brady.farmer@elitewireless.com with your questions.
Sincerely,
Brady Farmer
Elite Wireless

______________________________________________

To: Joann Majors [j.majors@honnemail.com]
From: Brady Farmer [brady.farmer@elitewireless.com]
Date: March 4
Subject: Re: phone plan
Dear Ms. Majors,
In regard to your query, it is possible to cancel your Elite Regular Plan at any time by requesting early termination. However, you will be obliged to pay an early termination fee. The fees are a minimum of $80 for a one-year plan, $150 for a two-year plan, and $180 for a three-year plan. However, other charges may apply if, in addition to your monthly subscription, you decide to purchase a mobile phone upgrade from us.
The information you requested on our devices is below. Click on any of the names to view more information on our Web site:
Crosscode SlimTouch with fingerprint security
Crosscode HighLine with extended battery life
Gogotel TX800 with 18-megapixel camera
Thank you,
Brady Farmer
Client services representative

childQuestions.questionText: According to the advertisement, what is NOT true about Elite Wireless?
options: (A) It can help save customers money on calls.
(B) It has service packages available for businesses.
(C) It offers unlimited texting to any location.
(D) It charges a minimum of $50 in regular monthly fees.
correctOptions: (C) It offers unlimited texting to any location.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information: Elite Wireless is now pleased to offer all its regular plan users unlimited* international calls and texting.

*Not all countries are applicable. To see a list of applicable locations, check the Web site.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin: Elite Wireless hiện vui mừng cung cấp cho tất cả người dùng gói thông thường cuộc gọi và nhắn tin quốc tế không giới hạn*.

*Không áp dụng cho tất cả các quốc gia. Để xem danh sách các địa điểm áp dụng, hãy kiểm tra trang web.

childQuestions.questionText: What is indicated about Ms. Majors?
options: (A) She places a lot of international calls because of her job.
(B) She will get a free period of service if she takes Mr. Farmer's suggestion.
(C) She previously attempted to call a number to ask some questions.
(D) She is eligible for a free telephone upgrade after a period of two years.
correctOptions: (B) She will get a free period of service if she takes Mr. Farmer's suggestion.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information: Sign up for 12 months by April 1, and pay nothing for your first month of service

The mailing date is February 20, and Mr. Farmer suggested that she switch to the 1-year plan
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin: Đăng ký 12 tháng trước ngày 1 tháng 4, và không phải trả phí cho tháng đầu tiên sử dụng dịch vụ.

Ngày gửi thư là ngày 20 tháng 2, và ông Farmer đã đề nghị bà chuyển sang gói 1 năm.

childQuestions.questionText: What might Ms. Majors use to register for a phone service?
options: (A) A product serial code
(B) A special number
(C) A usage pattern report
(D) A credit card
childQuestions.transcript: Information: To activate the new service, simply visit www.elitewireless. com and enroll using this special code: 5A6792B, or call 555-8383.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin: Để kích hoạt dịch vụ mới, chỉ cần truy cập www.elitewireless.com và đăng ký bằng mã đặc biệt này: 5A6792B, hoặc gọi số 555-8383.

childQuestions.questionText: What does Mr. Farmer suggest about Elite Wireless?
options: (A) It will waive cancellation fees under some circumstances.
(B) It offers customers several subscription plan durations.
(C) It requires that customers buy a mobile phone from the company.
(D) It gives discounts on phones and devices to long-term subscribers.
correctOptions: (B) It offers customers several subscription plan durations.
childQuestions.transcript: Information: The fees are a minimum of $80 for a one-year plan, $150 for a two-year plan, and $180 for a three-year plan
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin: Các khoản phí tối thiểu là $80 cho gói một năm, $150 cho gói hai năm, và $180 cho gói ba năm.

childQuestions.questionText: What did Ms. Majors ask Mr. Farmer to do?
options: (A) Add unlimited international data to a contract
(B) Provide figures that support statements in the letter
(C) Switch her plan based on her e-mail
(D) Send details on the free phones being offered
correctOptions: (D) Send details on the free phones being offered
childQuestions.transcript: Information in the second email: The information you requested on our devices is below. Click on any of the names to view more information on our Web site. And following this is the name of phones.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin trong email thứ hai: Thông tin bạn yêu cầu về các thiết bị của chúng tôi được liệt kê bên dưới. Nhấp vào bất kỳ tên nào để xem thêm thông tin trên trang web của chúng tôi. Và sau đây là tên của các điện thoại.
